messages.content: [Matt Braly] Matthew Benjakarn Braly (born November 8, 1988) is a Thai-American animator, storyboard artist, writer, and director. He is best known as the creator and executive producer of the Disney Channel animated series Amphibia. He also worked as a director on Gravity Falls and Big City Greens.
